question: Given one earlier day of labeled M1 population activity and first60seconds of labeled next-day activity, reconstruct trailing20ms planar hand velocity on the complete later next-day assessment.
unit: One macaque Indy, two consecutive recording days; correlated time windows are not independent biological replicates.

binning.edges: Exact stored native t[0],t[5],...,t[last]; no floating inferred index clock.
binning.spike_bin: [edge_i, edge_i+1), including left edge and excluding right. Reject nonfinite values; all five released sort slots contribute once per electrode; explicit empty dimensions imply no events. No event sorting requirement for histogram; report monotonicity and out-of-support counts without filtering supported events.
binning.spike_integer_accumulator: uint64, assert exact nonnegative integer<=UINT32_MAX before uint32 output; no saturation/wrap
binning.event_support: Only events within [t0,t_last) can contribute; complete fixed windows and out-of-support counts declared before values. No firing-rate/event-count threshold.
binning.per_prediction_observation: Ten consecutive20ms count bins [t_end-.2,t_end), oldest lag then channel; no future bin, interpolation, centered kernel or smoothers.
binning.target: v_xy=-0.01*(finger_pos[1:3,5*k]-finger_pos[1:3,5*(k-1)])/(t[5*k]-t[5*(k-1)]), m/s; released source axes are(z,-x,-y)cm per official loader. No centered derivative.
binning.value_failure_policy: Any nonfinite selected source/calibration/assessment target or selected timestamp blocks whole pilot; no outcome-dependent trimming or replacement.

splits.guard: No target-calibration labels after60s; first assessment prefix starts at60s and ends60.2s. Nine intermediate prediction endpoints are not part of either supervised split. All defined rows retained.
splits.boundary_index_check: Use frozen index boundaries, then require actual elapsed times at target bins3000/3010 equal60/60.2seconds within1e-7. Do not select or change rows with raw floating inequalities.

features.coordinate_order: lag oldest to newest, within lag exact frozen96channel order
features.normalization: Weighted training mean and population SD per feature, zero SD→1; fit inside each fold/model solely on that model allowed training rows. No assessment moments.
features.intercept: Weighted mean centering of feature and two targets; unpenalized intercept reconstructed after coefficient solve.

ridge.objective: sum_i w_i ||y_i-b-z_i B||² + lambda ||B||F²; weights sum1, B960×2.
ridge.selection_metric: Equal mean over four chronological validation-fold mean squared errors, axes equally weighted; finite scores required.
ridge.ties: Exact numerical tie chooses larger lambda; no tolerance-based discretionary tie.
ridge.source_folds: For j1..4: training endpoints10..3740*j; validation3740*j+10..3740*(j+1). Each validation3731rows,200ms support guard.
ridge.calibration_folds: For j1..4: training endpoints10..600*j; validation600*j+10..600*(j+1). Each validation591rows,200ms guard.
ridge.pooled_folds: All source-day rows plus calibration-fold training prefix; validate on same calibration-fold future block. Source and calibration total weights each0.5. All day1 precedes day2.
regimes: source_only: four source folds, uniform source training weights
calibration_only: four calibration folds, uniform target-prefix weights; no day1 labels or scaling
balanced_pooled: four calibration folds with all source rows, equal day total weights
ridge.solve_count_basis: 3regimes×4folds×4lambda=48 CV coefficient fits, plus3 final selected fits; reuse Gram products within each fold. Three selected lambdas may differ by predeclared selection rule.
ridge.solver: Float64 Cholesky of symmetric weighted Gram+lambdaI; no intercept penalty. Invalid/nonfinite fold, solve or selected lambda stops, no jitter/rescue/fallback.

calibration_residual_control: Add mean(calibration_true-source_model_calibration_prediction) two-vector to source predictions. Uses only calibration labels; no assessment fit.

metrics.primary: 0.5*(R²_x+R²_y) over all22091assessment windows, separately computed axis SST around each assessment-axis mean.
metrics.constant_axis: If either axis SST==0, primary undefined and task not numerically score-qualified; retain other descriptive metrics, no axis/case deletion.
secondary: fixed consecutive3000-row assessment blocks with final1091-row block, diagnostics only
metrics.signed_comparisons: All seven scores and all candidate-minus-reference R² plus reference-minus-candidate MSE/MAE; report pooled-vs-calibration-only/source-only and offset-vs-source-only contrasts without binary acceptance threshold.
metrics.independent_check: Separate scalar/math.fsum arithmetic over frozen candidate predictions and private target IDs; no reuse of scorer formula implementation.

controls_required_before_real_values: Generated timestamps exactly at left/right/prediction edge verify half-open binning and exclusion of future bins
Five sort slots including explicit empties; repeated equal timestamps count as released events, no dedup; overflow-downcast rejects

Generated linear ramp in negative source axes verifies sign,1cm→.01m and actual20ms denominator; perturbing later positions must not alter an earlier derived target (trusted converter itself prepares all private targets).
Exact source/calibration/assessment rows and guard supports, no physical overlap of supervised calibration and assessment prefixes
Generated fixed-score cases including negative R², constant-axis undefined, swapped/wrong/missing IDs and nonfinite targets/predictions
Generated weighted ridge/intercept, source-only/cal-only allowed-row isolation, CV guard/fold counts and deterministic lambda tie
publication_limits: This is a historical public development pair with one biological animal; no population CI, new-animal generalization or published SOTA claim.

Reference readouts use only each window past features, but batch query access exposes later neural windows. A truly online agent condition still needs a sequential provider; feature timing alone is not a proof of online information access.
Pooled versus calibration-only is a complete prespecified recipe comparison. Training data also changes scaling and selected penalty; it is not an isolated causal effect of neural information.
No behavioral persistence using hidden assessment velocity; only the first60seconds can inform the calibration controls.

Official NDT3 preprocessing uses resampling/gradient choices not reproduced here. This causal backward-difference target is explicitly defined; do not label its scores official NDT3 score reproduction.
